training_evidence: Read-only train_state_audit.json from the three original-TRAIN origins, never outer labels: low-power descending H2 unbounded fit coefficients are -0.233/-0.202/-0.189, while low-power ascending are 0.864/0.836/0.850. This supports testing state heterogeneity, not claiming causal mechanism or guaranteed future gain. Prior v17 and all old results remain negative/retained as recorded.
state: Six fixed observed states: last completed hourly power/rated capacity bins <0.1, [0.1,0.9), >=0.9, crossed with sign(last10min minus hourly mean). Both were v15 inputs. No future state/weather/target feature; no clustering or threshold search. Hourly eligibility remains history72->direct h1,h2, stride3. Actual executor consumes last-hour mean and end tick, NOT all72h.
fit: One bounded coefficient per state per lead, centered on the corresponding exact cached v15 prior. Fixed convex ridge objective sum((truth-anchor)-delta*coefficient)^2 + lambda*(coefficient-prior)^2 with lambda=sum(delta^2)/6 on FIT only. Closed-form coefficient clipped to [0,1]. A cell requires >=24 distinct issue clocks AND >=7 UTC issue days; otherwise exact old prior. Maximum12 stored coefficients, no intercept, no learning rate/seed/penalty/loss search. Do not refit old v15 experts.
selection: Three purged original-TRAIN origins70/80/90. Admit each lead separately only if MAE AND RMSE are non-worse than BOTH v15 AND Persistence in EVERY train query block, tolerance1e-8, and mean lead error ratio improves beyond1e-8. A failing lead remains exact v15; no cross-lead compensation. If neither qualifies, no final fit and no new outer evaluation. One algorithm, not a search over state definitions or lead masks.
budget: Only three state fits, at most one final fit with frozen enabled-lead flags and one outer report. CPU own2threads, no CUDA. No additional candidate/fold/seed, no v17 rerun, no Wiki. If rejected, end this protocol rather than tune its state boundaries/penalty.
primary_success: Report both lead metrics plus overall MAE/MSE/RMSE/R2/Skill/capacity hits and paired time-block CI/Newey-West vs v15. Overall MAE/RMSE must both improve vs v15 and Persistence, and neither lead's MAE or RMSE may worsen vs v15. Disabled leads must be bitwise v15. Do not change model after outer result. Historically inspected outer is development evidence, not independent confirmation or Wiki contribution.
forbidden: future raw ticks or future wind features
